people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
translations.bsb: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
translations.kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
